blocks.prompt: 8. If one geometric mean \(G\) and two arithmetic means \(p\) and \(q\) be inserted between two positive numbers, show that \(G^{2} = (2p - q)(2q - p)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh proof hai. Do positive numbers ko \(a\) aur \(b\) keh lete hain.
Ek G.M. ka matlab \(a, G, b\) G.P. mein hain, is liye \(G^{2} = ab\). Do A.M. ka matlab \(a, p, q, b\) A.P. mein hain.
Plan: \(a\) aur \(b\) ko \(p\) aur \(q\) ki shakal mein likhenge, phir \(G^{2} = ab\) mein rakh denge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: positive numbers \(a, b\); \(a, G, b\) G.P. mein; \(a, p, q, b\) A.P. mein.
Saabit karna hai: \(G^{2} = (2p - q)(2q - p)\).
Tareeqa: G.P. se \(G^{2}\) ka formula, aur A.P. se \(a\) aur \(b\) ko \(p, q\) mein likhna. Jawab mein sirf \(p, q\) hain, is liye \(a, b\) ko khatam karna hai.

Geometric mean istemal karein
\[G^{2} = ab \quad (1)\]
Kyun: G.P. \(a, G, b\) mein ratio barabar hai: \(\frac{G}{a} = \frac{b}{G}\), cross multiply se \(G^{2} = ab\).

Common difference nikalein
\[d = q - p\]
Kyun: A.P. \(a, p, q, b\) mein kisi bhi term se pichla term nikalein to common difference (mushtarka farq) \(d\) aata hai. Beech ke do terms \(p, q\) humein maloom hain, is liye unhi se \(d\) liya.

\(a\) aur \(b\) ko \(p, q\) mein likhein
\[a = p - d = p - (q - p) = 2p - q\]
\[b = q + d = q + (q - p) = 2q - p\]
Kyun: \(a\) term \(p\) se ek qadam pehle hai, is liye \(p\) mein se \(d\) ghata diya. \(b\) term \(q\) se ek qadam baad hai, is liye \(q\) mein \(d\) jama kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(p - (q - p)\) mein bracket ke bahar minus hai; bracket kholne par \(-q + p\) banta hai, is liye \(2p - q\). Yahan sign ki ghalti bohat aam hai.

(1) mein rakhein
\[G^{2} = (2p - q)(2q - p)\]
Kyun: \(a\) aur \(b\) ki qeematein \(G^{2} = ab\) mein rakh di; ab jawab sirf \(p\) aur \(q\) mein hai, jo saabit karna tha.

Tasdeeq: numbers se
\[a = 1,\ b = 4:\ p = 2,\ q = 3,\ G^{2} = 4\]
\[(2p - q)(2q - p) = (1)(4) = 4\]
Kyun: \(1, 2, 3, 4\) A.P. hai aur \(1, 2, 4\) G.P. Dono taraf 4 aaya, is liye formula sahi hai.
